capabilities: Pull Basecamp messages into one note per message
Add comments as callouts under a Comments heading
Pull only new or changed messages on later runs
Skip notes you have edited and rename notes on title changes
disambiguation: Not a Basecamp client for writing: it only reads from Basecamp and never creates, edits, or deletes anything there.
extras: Desktop only; requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or later. Mobile is unsupported because sign-in runs a temporary local web server on 127.0.1 at a random port. Access tokens are kept in Obsidian's secret storage, so each computer must connect separately. Images and files are linked back to Basecamp, not downloaded. No telemetry.
problem: Basecamp message board discussions live outside the vault, so they cannot be searched, linked, or edited alongside other notes.
summary: Plugin that pulls Basecamp message boards and their comments into the vault as Markdown notes, one note per message.
